title: "No Decision" Is Not a Close-Loss Reason: Why Your CRM Data Is Lying to You
summary: The episode examines RevOps evolution and conversational intelligence underutilization. It discusses shifting from traditional CRM data tooling toward genuine buyer signals, targeted outreach importance, and how conversation analysis might reduce CRM data dependency.
keyQuote: Why rolling up meeting transcripts across your pipeline reveals insights your CRM never will.
guestBio: Founder of RevOps consultancy GTM Layer.
takeaways: AI and automation's role in sales operations
Context and value emphasis in sales processes
